title: Advice for LGBTQ+ Travellers to Tanzania
excerpt: Same-sex relationships are illegal in Tanzania. Practical, honest advice for LGBTQ+ travellers who want to visit.
body:
We want every traveller to feel welcome. It is also important to be honest about the situation in Tanzania.

## The law

Same-sex sexual relations are illegal in Tanzania, including Zanzibar. Public attitudes are generally conservative.

## In practice

Many LGBTQ+ travellers visit Tanzania without problems. Discretion is advised: avoid public displays of affection, which is also advised for heterosexual couples.

## Lodges and camps

Many lodges are used to international guests. We can arrange suitable rooms, such as a room with a double bed or two singles, as you prefer.

## Official advice

Check your government's travel advice. Many governments have specific advice for LGBTQ+ travellers.

## Our approach

Tell us what you need. We plan discreetly and work with partners who respect our guests.

[Plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
